=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_iinject_token_into_url (lines 3038-3055), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3074-3087) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded directly into HTTPS Git URLs while per-process `http.extraHeader` authentication was removed.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in process arguments, Git diagnostics, and persisted `.git/config`, and networked Git operations lose the intended credential-isolation contract.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url (line ~585) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick remote URLs embed `GH_TOKEN` or `GH_PAT` directly.
  WHY: Clone and push operations expose credentials in process listings, Git diagnostics, and persisted remote URLs.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:memory_ensure_branch lines 140-180 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Authenticated `_memory_git` calls were replaced with bare `git ls-remote` and `git push`, while the local token variable is unused.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false` and bare HTTPS origins, memory branch initialization cannot authenticate and fail-opens, leaving downstream memory operations unavailable.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:Configure git auth for memory helper clones step (lines ~78-80 existing, plus line ~86) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `GIT_CONFIG_*` authentication variables are exported only in one workflow step and are not persisted to `$GITHUB_ENV`.
  WHY: Later memory steps start without authentication; severity disagreement exists, with the highest severity being critical.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:normalize_path (lines 240-247), is_sensitive_target_path removed | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering was removed, allowing issue- or plan-derived paths such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh`, and credential files to be read into model prompts.
  WHY: Untrusted paths can expose repository credentials and Git metadata to the model provider.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context lines 536-716 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and path-byte accounting for headers, missing-file markers, binary markers, and overflow markers were removed.
  WHY: Untrusted path lists can produce output beyond the configured context budget; the highest severity is high.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:_run_semble_query calls inside `emit_context` lines 555–600 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Removing the path-count cap permits an unbounded sequential Semble subprocess for every supplied path.
  WHY: Large path lists can cause a 257 × approximately 30-second worst-case sequence and starve prompt construction.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:lines 665-671 (codex exec invocation) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Diagnose runs direct Codex with `--sandbox danger-full-access` instead of brokered, sanitized, read-only execution.
  WHY: Issue-derived content runs with workflow credentials and full filesystem/network access, allowing credential exfiltration or repository mutation.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:model_provider_broker_start, model_provider_broker_stop, model_provider_broker_prepare_codex_witer, model_provider_broker_prepare_codex_readonly, model_provider_broker_exec_sanitized, model_provider_broker_exec_unprivileged, model_provider_broker_grant_read_path all removed | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model-provider broker lifecycle and execution APIs were deleted while live workflows and scripts still invoke them.
  WHY: Model-facing phases fail with command-not-found and the credential-isolation boundary is removed.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:--process-group-file removed from usage and option parser (lines 7, 26-31, 49-69) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` was removed although `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh` still passes it for isolated editor launches.
  WHY: The guard exits with an unknown-option error before launching the editor, matching the repeated empty autofix failures.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:deleted `_isolated_group_alive`, `_signal_child_group`, `_reap_child_after_kill`, `_verify_isolated_group_stopped` (was lines 229-462) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Isolated editor descendants are no longer tracked, identity-checked, reaped, or verified after termination.
  WHY: A `sudo` wrapper can exit while descendants continue writing during cleanup, creating workspace races and survivor processes.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:git_with_github_auth and review_blocked_* functions removed (was lines ~493-508 and ~940-1410) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication and the review-blocked approval/reissue helper family were deleted while live judge and orchestrator callers remain.
  WHY: Judge pushes fail or become unauthenticated, and review-blocked terminal approval actions cannot be requested, approved, or consumed.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:_gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest lines 766-772, gh_pr_with_all_comments GraphQL path lines 913-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized PR comment payloads no longer include `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked approval verification cannot bind producer identity or validate trusted human approvers.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:--provider-base-url removed (lines 85-100, 143-148, 261) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The writer rejects the existing `--provider-base-url` option and hardcodes the public OpenRouter URL.
  WHY: Existing callers exit with an unknown-argument error, preventing security-pass configuration and bypassing the loopback broker.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:codex_config_assemble lines 62-94 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `codex_config_assemble` no longer accepts or forwards `--provider-base-url`.
  WHY: Every caller passing the existing option fails before configuration is written.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:imports at lines ~30 and 37 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module imports `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and `is_sensitive_target_path`, which the PR removed.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises `ImportError` before the targeted-file-context tests execute.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:staged-support restore block lines 98–237 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block depends on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, but no workflow creates or exports either variable.
  WHY: The guard is always false, so self-repository runs can still commit support-ref copies over branch-owned helper changes.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:lines 62-67 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `pre_assembled_static.txt` preserve path no longer restores the index or removes an untracked cached entry.
  WHY: A previously staged file can remain in the index and be committed unintentionally; severity disagreement exists, with the highest severity being high.

- minimax_minimax-m3: .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml "Send PR merged Telegram alert" and "Cleanup tracked Telegram messages" steps (lines 514–528, 590–600) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Telegram mismatch handling exits before sending a failure notification when the staged helper differs from the immutable checkout.
  WHY: The failing `tg_helpers.sh` verification is itself the Telegram path, so the consumer receives no failure notification.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Resolve support exclusively from validated job.workflow_sha, reject mutable fallbacks, and fail closed when the immutable checkout is unavailable.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml — the Configure git auth for memory helper clones step
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: The workflow's GIT_CONFIG_* authentication remains step-local; scripts/memory_helpers.sh removed `_memory_git` and `memory_ensure_branch` uses bare Git commands, so later memory operations cannot use the validated support checkout's authentication.

- requirement: Preserve existing triggers, interfaces, memory behavior, and Telegram no-op behavior when unconfigured.
  expected_change_site: scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/targeted_file_context.py, scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: Existing Git authentication wrappers, review-blocked APIs, broker lifecycle, process-group option, provider-base-url option, comment identity fields, sensitive-path filtering, per-process Git auth, and brokered diagnose execution were removed without equivalent behavior or caller migration.

- requirement: Add repository-wide regression coverage to prevent mutable action or helper references from returning.
  expected_change_site: CI contract tests and workflow audit scripts
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: Action-pin and immutable-support tests were added, but no regression guard covers the model-provider broker APIs, `_memory_git`, sensitive-path symbols, or `--provider-base-url` and related credential-leaking regressions.

- requirement: Fix every instance of each finding's defect class across this project's changes, not only the cited line.
  expected_change_site: All modified scripts and workflows, including review_apply_fixes.sh, review_rb_judge.sh, orchestrate_poll_process.sh, run_plan_codex.sh, and tests/test_targeted_file_context.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: Sibling callers still invoke deleted broker, stall-guard, review-blocked, provider-base-url, and targeted-file-co
